Name: RRRR Wizard 32 Portrait Redesign By Mar
Author: marguez98
Description:
[b][size=4]Choose one of these installation methods:[/size][/b]

[code]Installation with Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard Portraits[/code]Install Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard Portraits (Only the file: Vanilla-ish Wizard Portraits) and just replace the portraits

[code]Installation with Portraiture[/code]Download the portrait files and open the [b]Portraiture[/b] mod folder. Inside, find the [b]“portraits”[/b] folder and create a new folder named [b]“Wizard”[/b]. Place all the downloaded portrait files inside this folder.
Launch the game, talk to the Wizard, and press [b]P[/b] while the dialogue box is open to select the portraits.

A huge thank you to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Jellonip]Jellonip[/url][/b] for creating RRRR and for providing such an easy-to-follow [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1459]guide[/url] for beginners on how to adapt portraits!
